cards.ex: The athlete's coach focused on strategies to achieve peak performance during the Olympics.
cards.exUz: Sportchining murabbiyi Olimpiada o'yinlari davomida eng yuqori natijaga erishish strategiyalariga e'tibor qaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Sportda yoki boshqa faoliyatda erishilgan eng yaxshi natija yoki holat.

cards.ex: Marathon runners undergo grueling training for months before the race.
cards.exUz: Marafon yuguruvchilari poygadan oldin bir necha oy davomida juda qiyin mashg'ulotlardan o'tadilar.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq va charchatadigan mashg'ulot jarayoni.

cards.ex: She follows a strict fitness regime to maintain her health and energy.
cards.exUz: U sog'lig'ini va energiyasini saqlash uchun qattiq fitnes rejimiga amal qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Muntazam fitnes mashqlari va ovqatlanish tartibi.

cards.ex: It's important to stay active, even if it's just a short walk each day.
cards.exUz: Har kuni qisqa yurish bo'lsa ham, faol bo'lish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy faoliyatni davom ettirish, harakatchan bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's a true sports enthusiast, watching every game he can.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy sport muxlisi, qo'lidan kelgancha har bir o'yinni tomosha qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Sportni juda yaxshi ko'radigan va qiziqadigan odam.

cards.ex: Proper nutrition can significantly enhance performance in any sport.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri ovqatlanish har qanday sportda ishlashni sezilarli darajada yaxshilashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Natijalarni, imkoniyatlarni kuchaytirish, yaxshilash.

cards.ex: Long-distance runners need exceptional physical endurance.
cards.exUz: Uzoq masofaga yuguruvchilarga ajoyib jismoniy chidamlilik kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy zo'riqishga bardosh berish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Athletes often push themselves to their limits during competitions.
cards.exUz: Sportchilar ko'pincha musobaqalar davomida o'zlarini chegaragacha zo'riqtiradilar.
cards.uzDef: O'z qobiliyatingizning oxirgi nuqtasigacha harakat qilish.

cards.ex: To become a professional, you need to train rigorously every day.
cards.exUz: Professional bo'lish uchun har kuni qattiq mashq qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq va intizomli ravishda mashq qilish.

cards.ex: An active lifestyle can improve both physical and mental health.
cards.exUz: Faol turmush tarzi ham jismoniy, ham ruhiy salomatlikni yaxshilashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Muntazam jismoniy faoliyatni o'z ichiga olgan hayot tarzi.

cards.ex: My roommate is a total fitness freak; he's always at the gym.
cards.exUz: Mening xonadoshim fitnes ishqibozi; u doim sport zalida.
cards.uzDef: Fitnesga juda qattiq berilgan odam.

cards.ex: After the injury, it took him months to get back into shape.
cards.exUz: Jarohatdan so'ng, unga yana formaga kirish uchun bir necha oy kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi jismoniy holatga qaytish.

cards.ex: He had to withdraw from the tournament due to a sports injury.
cards.exUz: U sport jarohati tufayli turnirdan chiqishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Sport bilan shug'ullanish paytida olingan jarohat.

cards.ex: Her competitive spirit always pushes her to do her best.
cards.exUz: Uning raqobat ruhi uni har doim eng yaxshi natijaga erishishga undaydi.
cards.uzDef: G'alaba qozonish istagi va raqobatga tayyorlik.

cards.ex: Everyone loves an underdog story, especially in sports.
cards.exUz: Hamma kuchsiz jamoaning g'alabasi haqidagi hikoyani yaxshi ko'radi, ayniqsa sportda.
cards.uzDef: Kuchsiz hisoblangan jamoaning g'alaba qozonishi haqidagi hikoya.

cards.ex: I hired a personal trainer to help me achieve my fitness goals.
cards.exUz: Men fitnes maqsadlarimga erishishimga yordam berish uchun shaxsiy murabbiy yolladim.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy mashqlar bo'yicha shaxsiy maslahatchi.

cards.ex: Even a short walk can help you break a sweat.
cards.exUz: Hatto qisqa yurish ham terlashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy mashqlar natijasida terlash.

cards.ex: He needs to stop couch surfing and start exercising.
cards.exUz: U divanda yotishni to'xtatib, mashq qilishni boshlashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Passiv va harakatsiz hayot kechirish.

cards.ex: Setting a realistic fitness goal is the first step to success.
cards.exUz: Haqiqiy fitnes maqsadini qo'yish muvaffaqiyatga birinchi qadamdir.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holatni yaxshilash uchun qo'yilgan maqsad.

cards.ex: The team was praised for their sportsmanship conduct throughout the tournament.
cards.exUz: Jamoa turnir davomida sportcha xulqi uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Sportda adolatli va hurmatli xulq-atvor qoidalariga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: During the marathon, I hit a wall around mile 20.
cards.exUz: Marafon davomida men 20-mil atrofida devorga urildim.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga charchash yoki motivatsiyani yo'qotish.

cards.ex: Strength training is important for overall health and fitness.
cards.exUz: Kuch mashqlari umumiy salomatlik va fitnes uchun muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Mushaklarni kuchaytirishga qaratilgan mashqlar.

cards.ex: It's important to stay hydrated, especially during exercise.
cards.exUz: Ayniqsa mashq paytida namlikni saqlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Tanadagi suv muvozanatini saqlash.

cards.ex: Cross-training can help prevent injuries and improve overall fitness.
cards.exUz: Kross-trening jarohatlarning oldini olishga va umumiy fitnesni yaxshilashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil sport turlarini birlashtirgan mashqlar.

cards.ex: The new sports arena can accommodate thousands of spectators.
cards.exUz: Yangi sport maydoniga minglab tomoshabinlar sig'ishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Sport musobaqalari o'tkaziladigan joy.

cards.ex: The coach made them do a lot of conditioning drills before the season started.
cards.exUz: Murabbiy mavsum boshlanishidan oldin ularga ko'plab konditsionerlik mashqlarini qildirdi.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy holatni yaxshilashga qaratilgan mashqlar.

cards.ex: It takes a few weeks to get into the swing of a new exercise routine.
cards.exUz: Yangi mashqlar tartibiga ritmga tushish uchun bir necha hafta kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Sport mashg'ulotlariga moslashish, o'rganib qolish.

cards.ex: She's always trying to raise the bar for herself and her teammates.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'zi va jamoadoshlari uchun marrani ko'tarishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Standartlarni, maqsadlarni yuqoriroq o'rnatish.

cards.ex: He consulted a specialist in sports medicine after his injury.
cards.exUz: U jarohatidan keyin sport tibbiyoti bo'yicha mutaxassis bilan maslahatlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Sport jarohatlarini davolashga ixtisoslashgan tibbiyot sohasi.

cards.ex: That new training technique was a real game-changer for the team.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi mashg'ulot uslubi jamoa uchun haqiqiy o'yinni o'zgartiruvchi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni keskin o'zgartiradigan omil yoki shaxs.
